$comment: Every interactive control in Cadence, by route. e2e/controls.spec.ts fails if the page shows a control that matches no entry here, and runs each entry's action and expectation at 390x844 and 1440x900. route '*' applies everywhere; 'palette' is the open command palette.

controls.name: Skip to content
controls.effect: Moves keyboard focus to the main content

controls.name: Cadence, go to Runs
controls.effect: Opens the Runs view

controls.name: Runs
controls.effect: Opens the Runs view

controls.name: Signal
controls.effect: Opens the Signal view

controls.name: Detectors
controls.effect: Opens the Detectors view

controls.name: Stress matrix
controls.effect: Opens the Stress matrix view

controls.name: Decode
controls.effect: Opens the Decode view

controls.name: Evidence
controls.effect: Opens the Evidence view

controls.name: ^Commands
controls.effect: Opens the command palette

controls.name: Theme
controls.effect: Switches between system, light and dark theme

controls.name: About this project
controls.effect: Opens Evidence, where the About section is

controls.name: ^What is .+\?$
controls.effect: Opens a plain-language explanation; Escape closes it

controls.name: ^CSV: .+
controls.effect: Downloads the table as CSV with a provenance line

controls.name: ^PNG: .+
controls.effect: Downloads the chart as PNG with a provenance footer

controls.name: Choose CSV files
controls.effect: Opens the file picker for tshark CSV files

controls.name: Provenance
controls.effect: Filters runs by provenance

controls.name: Label
controls.effect: Filters runs by normal / covert

controls.name: Used as
controls.effect: Shows test runs, baseline runs or all

controls.name: ^Open .+ in Signal$
controls.effect: Opens that run in the Signal view

controls.name: ^Manifest of .+$
controls.effect: Shows the run's manifest or generation parameters

controls.name: Close dialog
controls.effect: Closes the manifest dialog

controls.name: ^Show \d+ more runs$
controls.effect: Shows the next page of runs

controls.name: ^Provenance of .+
controls.effect: Marks an added file as real capture or simulated

controls.name: ^Label of .+
controls.effect: Labels an added file normal or covert

controls.name: ^Use of .+
controls.effect: Moves an added file between test and baseline runs (it leaves the test-run list)

controls.name: ^Bits sent in .+
controls.effect: Records the bits a covert file carried, for decoding

controls.name: ^Remove .+
controls.effect: Removes an added file

controls.name: Gaps shown end
